package steps

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os/exec"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

//truebdd:concept when "doubling"
func concept49c5ece16061081405dd19dacacf9182109378be8a0f1d472e9711fff19b790b(state *State, args []string) error {
	const hostRoot = "../.."
	if state.Program == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("double %s: the calculator is not installed", args[0])
	}
	command := exec.Command(state.Program, "double", args[0])
	command.Dir = hostRoot
	stdout, err := command.Output()
	if err != nil {
		var exit *exec.ExitError
		if errors.As(err, &exit) {
			return fmt.Errorf("run calc double %s: %w: %s", args[0], err, exit.Stderr)
		}
		return fmt.Errorf("run calc double %s: %w", args[0], err)
	}
	value, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(string(stdout)))
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("read the doubled integer from calc double %s stdout %q: %w", args[0], stdout, err)
	}
	state.Value = value
	return nil
}

package steps

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
)

func Register(suite Registrar) {
	suite.Step(`^the calculator is installed$`, installed)
	suite.Step(`^the result is (-?\d+)$`, result)

	suite.Step("^the Owner doubles (-?\\d+)$", concept49c5ece16061081405dd19dacacf9182109378be8a0f1d472e9711fff19b790b)
}

//truebdd:concept given "installation"
func installed(state *State, _ []string) error {
	program, err := filepath.Abs("../../tmp/calc-program/calc")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(program), 0o755); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	command := exec.Command("go", "build", "-o", program, "./services/calc")
	command.Dir = "../.."
	if output, err := command.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("install the calculator: %w: %s", err, output)
	}
	state.Program = program
	return nil
}

//truebdd:concept then "result"
func result(state *State, args []string) error {
	want, err := strconv.Atoi(args[0])
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if state.Value != want {
		return fmt.Errorf("expected %d, got %d", want, state.Value)
	}
	return nil
}
